extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants (PD/PI and institutional research administrators) preparing PHS 398 / SF424 R21/R33 applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the PHS 398 / SF424 research plan, budget (Research & Related Budget sections A–K), and required supplements/attachments for an NIH R21→R33 application (including human subjects, HESC, and animal study compliance).

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section A: Senior/Key Person
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide each Senior/Key Person with prefix, first/middle/last name, suffix, project role, base salary, calendar/academic/months (cal.months, acad.months, sum.months), requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form shows an entry for each PD/PI or Senior/Key person (e.g., 'Dr. Jerry Yang PD/PI 1.00'). List all senior/key personnel in the attached file if needed. Totals for Senior/Key persons should be provided (TotalFundsRequestedforallSeniorKeyPersonsin the attached file).

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section B: Other Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize other personnel by category (e.g., PostDoctoralAssociates, GraduateStudents, UndergraduateStudents, Secretarial/Clerical, LaboratoryTechnician, StudyDirector, AnimalTechnician) with number of personnel, months (cal./acad./sum), requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide TotalNumberOtherPersonnel and TotalOtherPersonnel costs; include TotalSalary,WagesandFringeBenefits (A+B). The example shows specific person-months (e.g., LaboratoryTechnician 5.00).

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section C: Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: List equipment items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000. Provide total funds requested for all equipment listed in the attached file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include an itemized equipment list for all items > $5,000 and attach supplemental equipment files if needed (Totalfundsrequestedforallequipmentlistedintheattachedfile).

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section D: Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify Domestic Travel Costs (includes Canada, Mexico, and U.S. possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs and provide totals for travel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate domestic and foreign travel; include funds requested per category and total travel cost.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section E: Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize tuition/fees/health insurance, stipends, travel, subsistence, and other participant/trainee support costs and list the number of participants/trainees and total participant/trainee support costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full breakout of participant/trainee costs (e.g., tuition, stipends) and the number of participants/trainees for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section F: Other Direct Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize Other Direct Costs, including Materials and Supplies, Publication Costs, Consultant Services, ADP/Computer Services, Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, Alterations and Renovations, Tuition Remission Fees, and other specified categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List each other direct cost type with FundsRequested($). Ensure totals of other direct costs are calculated (TotalOtherDirectCosts).

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section G: Direct Costs Total
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Total Direct Costs, i.e., cumulative total of Sections A through F (TotalDirectCosts(AthruF)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute G as the sum of A–F and display clearly on the budget form.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section H: Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($), and Funds Requested ($); include Modified Total Direct Cost (MTDC) or other bases as applicable (example: MTDC 54.50%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide cognizant federal agency name, POC and phone number, and date of most recent indirect cost rate negotiation agreement. Example entries show institutional F&A rates and cognizant agency contacts (DHHS Office of Inspector General; NIH Div. Fin. Services).

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section I: Total Direct and Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H) and the Total Direct and Indirect Funds Requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Calculate and display the grand total combining direct and indirect costs for the budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section J: Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, provide requested Fee funds in Section J.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include fee amounts as required by the funding mechanism and institution; show clearly on the budget form.

rubrics_metrics.name: RESEARCH & RELATED BUDGET – Section K: Budget Justification Attachment
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach a single Budget Justification file (filename and MIME type required).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only attach one file (e.g., '1243-FINALBUDG-JUST-UCSD[1].pdf'); the form explicitly states 'Only attach one file.' Provide a detailed budget justification in this attachment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative Budget Totals
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide cumulative budget totals across sections (SectionA Senior/KeyPerson, SectionB Other Personnel, SectionC Equipment, SectionD Travel (Domestic/Foreign), SectionE Participant/TraineeSupportCosts, SectionF OtherDirectCosts broken down by category, SectionG Direct Costs(AthruF), SectionH Indirect Costs, SectionI Total Direct and Indirect Costs(G+H), SectionJ Fee).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize number of personnel, totals for each budget category, and grand totals for clarity across the entire subcontract/subaward budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe each key and other person's role, person-months/effort, specific responsibilities, and tasks (e.g., synthesis, assays, supervision). Include other personnel (TBN placeholders permitted) and role-specific duties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide justification text for R21 and R33 phases where applicable (e.g., who does synthesis and in vitro testing, graduate researcher responsibilities). Include travel requests for personnel and overhead/F&A rate calculations and cognizant agency contact details and dates of indirect cost rate negotiation.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Research Plan – Required Sections/Attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Include the Research Plan sections and attachments: Introduction (for Resubmission/Revision), Specific Aims, Research Strategy (with Human Subjects sections), Protection of Human Subjects, Inclusion of Women and Minorities, Targeted/Planned Enrollment Table, Inclusion of Children, Vertebrate Animals, Consortium/Contractual Arrangements, Letters of Support, Resource Sharing Plan(s), Appendix, Progress Report Publication List, Select Agent Research, Multiple PD/PI Leadership Plan, Inclusion Enrollment Report, and any other applicable sections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach applicable sections per the form. The form lists attachments with filenames (e.g., '1241-AIMS-MIP.pdf', '1242-FINALRESSTRAT-MIPrv[1]'). Follow the PHS 398 instructions for which attachments are required for the application type (New/Resubmission/Renewal/Continuation/Revision).

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a concise Specific Aims page that states the overarching goal, the problem addressed, preliminary data supporting feasibility, and clearly enumerated aims for each project phase (e.g., R21 phase aims and R33 phase aims).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims should be numbered and specific (examples: Aim 1: test whether amyloid-binding small molecules inhibit semen-mediated enhancement of HIV infection; Aim 2: examine interaction with female reproductive tract cells). Include long-term goals and how R21 leads into R33. Emphasize feasibility/high-risk–high-reward nature where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy – Significance
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain the problem to be addressed, the urgency/importance of the work, and how the project addresses gaps in the field with supporting literature and preliminary data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discuss prior failures/limitations of current approaches (e.g., prior microbicide trials) and present evidence that the proposed approach addresses these issues; quantify impact (e.g., potential to reduce HIV transmissions).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy – Innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe novel concepts, approaches, or methodologies and how the proposed project is different from traditional strategies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlight novel targets (e.g., SEVI as a microbicide target), innovative molecules or assays, and why the approach is high-risk/high-reward relative to conventional virus-targeting microbicides.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Trial Supplement – Human Subjects / Clinical Trial Questions
rubrics_metrics.description: On the Cover Page Supplement indicate whether the project involves human subjects, whether it is an Agency-defined Phase III clinical trial, and provide PD/PI and applicant organization contact information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide complete contact and administrative information (names, addresses, phone/email), and explicitly answer Yes/No boxes for 'Human Subjects' and 'Clinical Trial' per form requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells (HESC) Supplement
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether the proposed project involves human embryonic stem cells; if so, list the registration number(s) of the specific cell line(s) from the NIH registry, or check the box that a registered line will be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide registry numbers or check the 'Specific stem cell line cannot be referenced at this time. One from the registry will be used.' box as required by the PHS 398 HESC supplement.

rubrics_metrics.name: GLP-compliant Rabbit Vaginal Irritation (RVI) Study Requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: If an RVI study is proposed under R33, perform the study under 21 CFR Part 58 (GLP) and designate a Study Director who will sign the study protocol, be the single point of study control, sign the final report, assure compliance with 21 CFR Part 58, interact with management and Quality Assurance Unit (QAU), and assure personnel training by education/experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: State the goal of the RVI (identify non‑irritating maximum tolerated dose and 'de-risk' the strategy). Describe GLP oversight, QC/data checks, and the role of consultants (e.g., QAU subcontractor) and training. Provide numbers and costs for animals and supplies where applicable (e.g., $240 per rabbit, 27 NZW rabbits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/Contractual Arrangements and Letters of Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide documentation of consortium/subcontract arrangements and letters of support; include subcontract PI roles, person-months on subawards, and subcontractor responsibilities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach consortium documents (e.g., '1256-CONSORTIA-MIP.pdf') and letters of support (e.g., '1257-LOS-Setof3-070710.pdf'). Detail subaward budgets and justifications consistent with the main application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Include plans for resource sharing (data, reagents, model organisms, software) as applicable and attach the Resource Sharing Plan(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the Resource Sharing Plan file (e.g., '1258-RESSHARE-MIPrv.pdf') and follow NIH expectations for data and material sharing appropriate to the funding opportunity.
